title: Standard
text: JSON Schemas, the closed assertion vocabulary, fixture policy and cost accounting rules.
label: STANDARD.md

title: Fixtures
text: Real open-hardware boards, permissively licensed, frozen at a pinned upstream commit and content-hashed. Baseline ERC and DRC are measured, not assumed.
label: FIXTURES.md

title: Worked tasks
text: An edit task with a calibrated surgicality bound and a refusal task graded on its citation rather than its tone.
label: tasks/

title: Validator, sandbox, scorer, records
text: The loop runs offline end to end: schema checks, hash verification, the three evidence adapters, verdicts, append-only records and re-scoring with no provider and no network.
label: scripts/

title: Agent mode
text: A provider-backed run needs a credential and is not implemented. An assertion whose evidence needs kicad-cli reports unevaluable when the tool is absent rather than guessing, so no verdict is ever manufactured.

title: Aggregate report and LEADERBOARD.md
text: pass@k with spread, correct and false refusal rates, the failure work queue and the generated markdown leaderboard with its consistency check.

title: First smoke matrix
text: Direct API models at three repeats. This page and the paper tables are regenerated from its records.
